description: What is this city like, in one page of measured facts?. One-city dossier for any of 6,902 cities with 100k+ people (176 countries): reported population and its rank in country and world, built-up agglomeration population 2000 and 2025 with growth and density percentiles (EU GHSL), central-3 km roads, rail and park share (OpenStreetMap via Overture), elevation, nearest large airport and seaport, and 1991-2020 monthly temperature and rainfall measured at the nearest NOAA station. Includes 5 computed insights and a ready-to-paste Markdown page. Facts only; sources and data date in the attribution. Rebuilt monthly. Routes: /answer (city*, country); /search (q*); /countries (limit). Paid $0.1 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /search, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
